title: Family organisation, finally simple
lead: Presence (even with shared custody), meals, shopping, tasks and calendar: everything that keeps the home running, shared between all family members, on everyone’s phone.

demo.custodyNext: At the other parent’s from Monday

questions.who: Who is eating at home tonight?
questions.kids: Are the kids with us this week?
questions.what: What are we eating this week?
questions.shopping: Did anyone remember to buy milk?

questionsAnswer: FamilyGest answers these questions for you.

presence.title: Presence and place settings
presence.text: Everyone says when they are away or at home, for lunch, dinner and the night. You always know how many will be at the table, guests included.

meals.title: Weekly menus
meals.text: Plan meals, find your recipes and add the ingredients to the shopping list in one tap.

polls.title: Meals to organise
polls.text: Suggest several dates to your guests: they vote from a simple WhatsApp link, without installing anything. You set the date and everything is recorded.

shopping.title: Shared shopping list
shopping.text: One list for the whole family, sorted by aisle, updated live by everyone.

tasks.title: Tasks and teamwork
tasks.text: Share out the tasks with due dates and reminders, and keep track of what is left to do.

calendar.title: Family calendar
calendar.text: Appointments, outings, multi-day holidays: the shared calendar, exportable to Google or Apple.

voice.title: By voice
voice.text: “Add milk to the shopping list”, “Paul won’t be here for lunch tomorrow”: talk to the app or to Alexa.

notifications.title: Always in the loop
notifications.text: Phone notifications and a daily summary by email, according to each person’s preferences.

custody.title: Every other week? It’s covered.
custody.text: Everyone sets their usual presence once, day by day, lunch, dinner and night, with a week A and a week B. FamilyGest knows who is home each day: all that is left is to report the exceptions.

points.rhythm: Same rhythm every week, or alternating
points.slots: By day and by meal, nights included

invite.title: I invite you
invite.text: You receive an invitation for your family, and each member creates their account in seconds.

install.title: You install it
install.text: No app store: the app is added to the phone’s home screen in two taps, just like a real app.

organise.title: Everyone gets organised
organise.text: Presence, meals, shopping and calendar fill up during the week, and everyone sees the same thing.

privacyText: A privately hosted family app: no advertising, no data resale. Each family only sees its own information.
finalText: Write to me: I will open a space for your family.
finalTextNoContact: Just ask me: I will open a space for your family.
